concepts.meaning: One ordered use of an existing Operation in a Workflow, identified independently of the Operation concept.
One declared recovery use of an Operation tied to a specific forward step, not to every use of that Operation.
An explicit ordering constraint between compensation occurrences, not a new canonical domain relationship.
An explicitly named source conversion candidate bound to an unchanged checked legacy graph; not execution or automatic file replacement.

distinctions: Operation identity is not step identity
repeated use is not duplicate domain edge
same bare name is not same qualified Operation
compensation target is one step occurrence
migration candidate is not a validated replacement graph
